Here is a snip of button coloring. This changes your sidebar and tab bar buttons (can be separated though) to the same colors.

It also gives the effect of fading in and out, but if you don't like that, just remove the transition and opacity stuff.

/* Button colors separated for light and dark */
/* Side buttons */
.dark .side button,
.dark .btn-whoaverse.contribute,
.dark .pagination-container .btn-whoaverse-paging a,
.dark .btn-whoaverse-paging,
.dark .btn-sub,
.dark .btn-sub a,
.dark .btn-unsub,
.dark .btn-unsub a, 
.dark .tabmenu li.disabled a,
.dark .tabmenu li a,
.dark .tabmenu li.selected a,
.dark .tabmenu li.disabled a.contribute,
.dark .tabmenu li.selected a.contribute {
 border-width: 1px;
 background: #292929; /* This is the normal button color */
 border-color: transparent;
 color: white !important;
 transition: .2s ease-in-out;
 -moz-transition: .2s ease-in-out;
 -webkit-transition: .2s ease-in-out;
}
.dark .side button:hover,
.dark .btn-whoaverse.contribute:hover,
.dark .pagination-container .btn-whoaverse-paging a:hover,
.dark .btn-whoaverse-paging:hover,
.dark .btn-sub:hover,
.dark .btn-sub a:hover,
.dark .btn-unsub:hover,
.dark .btn-unsub a:hover,
.dark .tabmenu li.selected a:hover,
.dark .tabmenu li.disabled a:hover,
.dark .tabmenu li.disabled a.contribute:hover,
.dark .tabmenu li.selected a.contribute:hover,
.dark .tabmenu li a:hover {
 background: #c0c0c0; /* This is the button color while hovering it */
 color: #292929; /* This is the text color while hovering over it */
 border-color: transparent;
 opacity: 0.8;
}
.light .side button,
.light .btn-whoaverse.contribute,
.light .pagination-container .btn-whoaverse-paging a,
.light .btn-whoaverse-paging,
.light .btn-sub,
.light .btn-sub a,
.light .btn-unsub,
.light .btn-unsub a,
.light .tabmenu li.disabled a,
.light .tabmenu li a,
.light .tabmenu li.selected a,
.light .tabmenu li.disabled a.contribute,
.light .tabmenu li.selected a.contribute {
 border-width: 1px;
 background: #c0c0c0; /* This is the normal button color */
 border-color: transparent;
 color: white !important;
 transition: .2s ease-in-out;
 -moz-transition: .2s ease-in-out;
 -webkit-transition: .2s ease-in-out;
}
.light .side button:hover,
.light .btn-whoaverse.contribute:hover,
.light .pagination-container .btn-whoaverse-paging a:hover,
.light .btn-whoaverse-paging:hover,
.light .btn-sub:hover,
.light .btn-sub a:hover,
.light .btn-unsub:hover,
.light .btn-unsub a:hover,
.light .tabmenu li.selected a:hover,
.light .tabmenu li.disabled a:hover,
.light .tabmenu li.disabled a.contribute:hover,
.light .tabmenu li.selected a.contribute:hover,
.light .tabmenu li a:hover {
 background: #333333; /* This is the button color while hovering it */
 color: #0c0c0c; /* This is the text color while hovering over it */
 border-color: transparent;
 opacity: 0.8;
}
